domain: All contiguous windows of flattened PR1122 A with one common frame, exactly five distinct wires and at most 12 elementary ADDs. No frame crossing, new wire, COPY, bridge or recursive child.
method: Complete BFS over all 9999360 GL(5,2) matrices and 20 ordered ADDs. Generator pairs sorted by ((5*destination+source)^13,5*destination+source). One shortest representative per matrix. Require strict shortening and participation of all five wires. Weighted interval DP chooses maximum total saved ADDs, ties keep earlier-ending solution. In ascending interval order admit each selected replacement only after recomputing full word F/B and both precision caps; reject once, no reoptimization or restart.
cleanup: Rebuild literal C as reversed z-destination A+B. Lower every ADD/COPY and check whole semantic and native compositions.
optimistic_full_cost: 10652 - 2*sum(old_length-shortest_length) ADDs; unchanged 661 registers, 9 returns, paid histogram, frame transitions, bridges, physical 104/192-bit allocation. Actual F/B and exact all-prefix bounds decide admission. No kappa claim.
falsification: Stop if the census has no shortening beyond the PR936 <=6-word coverage and no useful new exact local-floor evidence. At most one bounded pivot, no seed redraw.
